subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
12.  
Standard hours required for doing a work is 100 hours and budgeted hours is 120 hrs. 
while the same work is actually completed by workers in 110 hrs. You are required to 
calculate the activity ratio: 
(A)  
109.09% 
(B)  
83.33% 
(C)  
90.90%  
(D)  
110% 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (B) 83.33% Activity Ratio = Standard Hours ×100 Budgeted Hours = 83.33%
